Shanghai Municipal Council. 710 144/16

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL POLICE FORCE）
POLICE FORCE,
(DETECTIVE BRANCH)

November 13th 1916

Sir,

General Yang has received a report from his intelligence officers that Tsung Kwaung Lieu 曾廣 has established an office in Frenchtown and is trying to induce the ex-Honan rebels to join him.
Loo Vung San 陸榮森 has visited General Li Ts'ing Woo 李清泉 at his home in Avenue Edward VII and asked him for money to disband his followers. General Li refused to give him anything saying that Loo was not a proper rebel.
The Civil Governor of Hunan named Dan Tsoo Yi 譚祖義 arrived here on 12th inst and is staying in a house opposite the Municipal Gaol in Ward Road.
Dr. Wu Ting Fang has received a telegram from the President urging him to go to Peking immediately.

Your Obedient Servant,

（签名）

Captain Superintendent of Police.
pages.zh:
上海工部局。710 144/16

（印：上海工部局警务处）
警务处，
（侦探股）

1916年11月13日

先生：

杨将军从其情报人员处获悉，曾廣（Tsung Kwaung Lieu）已在法租界设立办事处，并正试图诱使前河南叛军加入其阵营。

陆荣森（Loo Vung San）已前往李清泉（Li Ts'ing Woo）将军位于爱多亚路（Avenue Edward VII）的寓所拜访，并向其索要遣散部下的经费。李将军拒绝给予任何资助，称陆并非真正的叛军首领。

湖南省民政长谭祖义（Dan Tsoo Yi）于本月12日抵达此地，现寓居华德路（Ward Road）市立监狱对面的一处住宅内。

伍廷芳博士收到总统发来的电报，促其立即赴京。

您顺从的仆人，

（签名）

警务处总监
